title: ANÁLISIS API BÚSQUEDA + TESTING - Tus Aguacates
executive_summary: Se analizaron 2 endpoints de búsqueda: (1) Vercel API (/api/agent/products) y (2) PostgreSQL directo en workflow n8n. La Vercel API tiene mejor manejo de acentos, plurales y scoring, pero NO es usada por el workflow de producción. El workflow usa PostgreSQL LIKE directo que es ACENTO-SENSIBLE, lo que causa que productos con acentos (ñ, é, ó) NO sean encontrables por clientes que escriben sin acentos (~30%+ del catálogo). Se identificaron 8 gaps incluyendo un bug crítico en el manejo de stop words de la API y falsos positivos por substring matching.

strengths: Acento-insensitive (NFD normalization en búsqueda y producto)
Stop word filtering para multi-word queries
weaknesses: BUG: Stop words + single-word path = no variant matching (GAP-1)
False positives en substrings cortos (piña→Espinaca, papa→Papaya)

architecture_findings.node_1_sql: LIKE matching en productos_tienda con singularización básica
node_1_issues: CRÍTICO: PostgreSQL LIKE es acento-sensitive. Customer dice 'champinones', pre-processing normaliza NFD → 'champinones', SQL busca LIKE '%champinones%' contra 'Champiñones enteros' → FALLA (ñ≠n)
Solo singularización simple (saca 's'/'es'), no plural handling bidireccional
No accent normalization a nivel DB (solo en pre-processing JS)
architecture_findings.node_2_query: ILIKE con $1 replacement from AI model
node_2_issues: Mismo problema de acentos (ILIKE también es accent-sensitive)
Usa credenciales 'Postgres account' diferente al 'Mi PostgreSQL Docker' principal

key_apis_difference.conclusion: The Vercel API is objectively superior for search. The workflow should use it.

test_matrix_results.found: Papa criolla + sabanera (+ Papaya false positive)

gaps.title: Stop words + single word path = no variant matching
gaps.description: When 'las naranjas' is searched, stop word 'las' is stripped, leaving 'naranjas' as a single word. The single-word path checks `name.includes('naranjas')` but doesn't try the singular variant 'naranja'. Result: 'Naranja valencia' is NOT matched.
gaps.fix: In productMatchesSearch(), the single-word check should also check getSingularPluralVariants() of the word.
gaps.fix_code: if (words.length === 1) { const variants = getSingularPluralVariants(words[0]); if (variants.some(v => normalizedName.includes(v)) || ...) }

gaps.title: n8n PostgreSQL search is accent-sensitive — productos con acentos NO son encontrables
gaps.description: The PRODUCCION workflow searches products via PostgreSQL LIKE. PostgreSQL LIKE is accent-sensitive. The n8n pre-processing strips accents (NFD). Result: customer types 'champinones' → pre-processing → 'champinones' → SQL `LIKE '%champinones%'` → DB has 'Champiñones enteros' → 'ñ'≠'n' → NO MATCH. This affects ~30%+ of the catalog.
gaps.fix: Migrate '3. Búsqueda Automática Productos' from PostgreSQL to Vercel API HTTP Request. The Vercel API normalizes accents before comparing.

gaps.title: No typo tolerance
gaps.description: 'arbeja' (typo for 'arveja') returns 0 results. No fuzzy matching, no Levenshtein fallback.
gaps.fix: Add Levenshtein distance check when search returns 0 results, try alternatives within 1-2 edits.

gaps.title: No regional synonym mapping
gaps.description: 'calabaza' returns 0, but 'auyama' (used in Colombia) returns 1. Other affected: 'elote'→'maíz', 'judías'→'habichuela', 'patatas'→'papas'.
gaps.fix: Add a synonym dictionary and normalize search terms through it.

gaps.title: False positives from substring matching
gaps.description: No word boundary enforcement: 'piña'→'Espinaca', 'papa'→'Papaya', 'mora'→'Lechuga morada'. Short substrings in longer words cause irrelevant matches.
gaps.fix: Use word boundary regex for words <5 chars, or enforce minimum match ratio.

gaps.title: AGENT_OPS_API_KEY not configured in production tools
gaps.description: TOOL_BuscarProductos in lab workflow references 'CONFIGURAR_AQUI_NUEVA_AGENT_OPS_API_KEY' placeholder. Old key (4d8cfb14fba5451c875ac515fa047f9b) works but should use a proper configured key.
gaps.fix: Generate/configure new AGENT_OPS_API_KEY in Vercel env vars and n8n tools.

gaps.title: Missing products in catalog
gaps.description: 'yuca' returns 0 results. Customer may expect this product.

gaps.title: Search scoring not used by workflow
gaps.description: Vercel API returns _searchScore but workflow ignores it. AI agent could use it for better relevance decisions.

recommendations.action: Migrate '3. Búsqueda Automática Productos' from PostgreSQL to Vercel API HTTP Request
recommendations.why: The PostgreSQL LIKE search is fundamentally broken for accented characters. ~30%+ of products (Champiñones, Limón, Pimentón, etc.) are unfindable when customers type without accents.
recommendations.how: Replace PostgreSQL node with HTTP Request: GET /api/agent/products?search={{terminoBusqueda}}&limit=10&active_only=true with x-agent-key header. Adjust response parsing in '4. Merge Datos + Productos'.

recommendations.action: Fix GAP-1: Stop word + single-word variant matching
recommendations.why: Searches with articles like 'las naranjas' or 'unas fresas' return 0 results when they should find products.
recommendations.how: Modify productMatchesSearch() in products/route.ts: in the single-word path (words.length===1), check getSingularPluralVariants() of the word.

recommendations.action: Add synonym dictionary for regional terms
recommendations.how: Add const SYNONYMS in products/route.ts and apply normalizeSearchTerm() before matching.

recommendations.action: Add word boundary enforcement for short substrings
recommendations.how: For terms <5 chars, use word boundary regex instead of includes().
When search returns 0, try within 2 edits of the search term.

recommendations.why: Remove placeholder keys from production workflow.
recommendations.how: Set AGENT_OPS_API_KEY in Vercel env vars, reference in n8n code node.

node_3_search.sql_query: WITH search_terms AS (...), productos_match AS (...) SELECT ... FROM productos_tienda ... WHERE is_active = true AND (LOWER(name) LIKE ... ) ORDER BY match_priority LIMIT 10
node_3_search.singularization: CASE WHEN term ~ 'es$' AND length>4 THEN trim(trailing 'es') WHEN term ~ 's$' AND length>3 THEN trim(trailing 's')
node_3_search.sorting: CASE WHEN name LIKE term||'%' THEN 1, category LIKE '%'||term||'%' THEN 2, name LIKE '%'||term||'%' THEN 3, description THEN 4

node_TOOL_BuscarProductos.sql_query: SELECT id, name, COALESCE(discount_price, price) as precio, description, category_name FROM productos_tienda WHERE is_active=true AND price>0 AND stock>0 AND (name ILIKE '%'||$1||'%' OR description ILIKE... ) ORDER BY is_featured, name LIMIT 3
node_TOOL_BuscarProductos.note: Uses 'Postgres account' credentials (different from 'Mi PostgreSQL Docker')
